The HWPX intake summary generation succeeded with a perfect reward score, validating the XML parsing and document structure logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without errors. The hermes (kimi-k2.5) agent successfully processed the adhoc dataset, though the 0.75 judge_reward suggests potential for refinement in output formatting or edge-case handling. Future iterations should reuse the current XML extraction patterns while verifying robustness against malformed HWPX schemas.
